name: com.52choujiang/kuaishou-insights
title: SocialDataX 快手 Kuaishou MCP
description: 快手/Kuaishou hot search, work/user search, work details, comments/replies, creator profiles, works, and speech-to-text transcript.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer API Key from SocialDataX / 社媒数据助手

tools.name: kuaishou_get_hot_search_list
tools.description: Fetch the current Kuaishou / 快手 short-video hot search list.

tools.name: kuaishou_search_videos
tools.description: Search Kuaishou works by natural-language keyword with optional page_token continuation; do not pass page.

tools.name: kuaishou_search_users
tools.description: Search Kuaishou users by natural-language keyword with optional page_token continuation; do not pass page.

tools.name: kuaishou_get_video_detail_by_photo_id
tools.description: Fetch structured work details when the caller already has a photo_id.

tools.name: kuaishou_get_video_detail_by_url
tools.description: Resolve a Kuaishou work page link, short link, or share text into structured work details.

tools.name: kuaishou_submit_video_speech_text_by_video_url
tools.description: Submit a Kuaishou work video speech-to-text transcript task from a work page link, short link, or share text. 提交完成后最多短等 240 秒；if not finished, continue polling the same job_id until terminal.

tools.name: kuaishou_submit_video_speech_text_by_photo_id
tools.description: Submit a Kuaishou work video speech-to-text transcript task from a photo_id. 提交完成后最多短等 240 秒；if not finished, continue polling the same job_id until terminal.

tools.name: kuaishou_get_video_speech_text_job
tools.description: Check a Kuaishou video speech-to-text transcript job by job_id without starting a new task. Each call waits up to 240 seconds for the same job. If unfinished, continue querying the same job_id until is_terminal is true. This v1 surface returns transcript plus content context, not summary.

tools.name: kuaishou_get_video_comments_by_photo_id
tools.description: Fetch paginated first-level comments when the caller already has a photo_id.

tools.name: kuaishou_get_video_comments_by_url
tools.description: Fetch paginated first-level comments directly from a Kuaishou work page link, short link, or share text.

tools.name: kuaishou_get_video_comment_replies_by_comment_id
tools.description: Fetch paginated replies under a first-level comment by photo_id and comment_id.

tools.name: kuaishou_get_user_info_by_user_id
tools.description: Fetch creator profile data when the caller already has a non-empty user_id.

tools.name: kuaishou_get_user_info_by_profile_url
tools.description: Resolve a Kuaishou profile link, including live/fw-user profile shares, short link, or share text into creator profile data; successful results return a reusable non-empty user_id.

tools.name: kuaishou_get_user_posted_videos_by_user_id
tools.description: Fetch a paginated list of works published by a creator when the caller already has a non-empty user_id.

tools.name: kuaishou_get_user_posted_videos_by_profile_url
tools.description: Fetch a paginated list of works published by a creator from a profile link, short link, or share text that resolves directly to a non-empty user_id; for live/fw-user profile shares, call creator profile first and use the returned non-empty user_id.
